subtitle: Lesson 31 · Capstone: Deploying and Administering an AWS Environment

code:
aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0meridianweb2 \
  --query "Reservations[].Instances[].PublicIpAddress"
# null

aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0meridianweb2 \
  --query "Reservations[].Instances[].SubnetId"
# subnet-0meridianpriv  <- the private subnet
caption: meridian-web2 was launched into the app tier's subnet by a copy-paste mistake.

code:
aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0meridianweb2

aws ec2 run-instances --subnet-id subnet-0meridianpub \
  --security-group-ids sg-0meridianweb \
  --associate-public-ip-address \
  --tag ... Value=meridian-web2
caption: A subnet can't be changed after launch — the fix is terminate, then relaunch right.
